pages.text: Health 220, Attack 8, Knockback Resistance 1.0, Movement Speed 0.25.$(br)By folding necromancy and a reaping scythe into a single reaper, you have made a Reaper Necromancer of your own - a mighty midnight hunter that will lend you its strength.
This necromancer is unlike other necromancers: it pours most of its necromantic power into casting its own spells rather than into summoning, and that makes it a formidable fighter in its own right.
If a Reaper Necromancer dies while you carry an empty soul jar, the jar takes their soul; right-click a Reaper with that jar and the Reaper is used as a new body to bring the necromancer back.
